evidence.quote: EDS analysis of the bright white phase reveals that its composition is 66.10 at.% O, 18.15 at.% Ho, 14.85 at.% Hf, 0.90 at.% Nb, in which the ratio of Ho : Hf : O is approximately 2 : 2 : 7. By means of analytical transmission electron microscopy (TEM), the light white phase is identified to be Ho 2Hf2O7
it is evident from Fig. 1 that Ho additions remarkably refine the microstructure, i. e., the size of the (Nb, Ti)5Si3 phases becomes much smaller with increasing Ho content.
the fracture surface of Ho-free alloys presents complete cleavage mode for both (Nb, Ti) solid solution matrix and (Nb, Ti) 5Si3, showing a large amount of cleavage planes.

The fracture exhibits a mixed fracture mode of cleavage of the (Nb, Ti) 5Si3 compound and the (Nb, Ti) solid solution matrix and local plastic deformation of the partial volume fraction of the (Nb, Ti) phase.

the mechanical properties will be deteriorated due to the formation of bigger cubic Ho 2Hf2O7 precipitates with increasing of the Ho content to about 0.2 at.%, which may act as the origin of crack initiation.
The addition of 0.1 at.% Ho leads to an increase in strength and fracture strain at RT of Dd = 127 MPa and De = 6 % respectively, compared to the Ho-free alloy.
The addition of 0.1 at.% Ho leads to an increase in strength and fracture strain at RT of Dd = 127 MPa and De = 6 % respectively, compared to the Ho-free alloy.
At 1473 K and 1573 K, the strength of the 0.1 at.% Ho-doped alloy increases by 100 MPa and 70 MPa respectively, compared with that of the Ho-free alloy.
At 1473 K and 1573 K, the strength of the 0.1 at.% Ho-doped alloy increases by 100 MPa and 70 MPa respectively, compared with that of the Ho-free alloy.
Therefore, Ho substituting for Nb and/or Si sites leads to a significant solid-solution strengthening effect.
The RE elements may reduce the surface tension of the liquid metal and the formation energy of grain nuclei, thus increasing the nucleation rate during solidification
The RE Ho can cause greater constitutional undercooling at the interface between solid and liquid due to its surface activity.
The decrease of the P – N barrier energy increases the dislocation mobility, compressive ductility and intrinsic fracture resistance in Nb solid solution alloys
